decisions.reason: As a narrowly incremental component that disappeared from the website after launch, it likely fell short of aspiration levels and is better treated as a failed market offer whose resources should be redeployed to stronger core and new-development projects.

The electric infrared panel heater had dedicated promotion in 2023 but no visible market presence in 2024, which suggests performance below aspirations and justifies problemistic search away from this line despite the firm's growth and slack.

Like Product B, the electric halogen infrared heater lost standalone visibility quickly, indicating weak enough results versus expectations and comparable offerings that management would discontinue it and reallocate attention to more promising technologies.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater gained stronger website prominence from 2023 to 2024 and fits the firm's strategic move toward lower-carbon, hydrogen-ready systems, so it likely meets or exceeds aspirations and merits continued support.
